messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up: Major retail customer needs a sales POC confined to EU+UK datacenters. Ask list: full EU+UK subprocessors CSV, BYO-HSM for keys, and a plain-English statement ensuring inference logs and model checkpoints remain in-region. Also they asked if we can route control-plane to UK only. Any instant no-gos?
ivy_se: Control-plane routing to UK-only is not a hosted self-serve feature. We can offer data-plane pinning to eu-west and eu-central and add dedicated control-plane nodes for UK but that'll be a dedicated/private run. What's their load profile?
sam_sales: Expected baseline ~90 qps, peaks ~250 qps during promos. Short chat contexts (avg 70 tokens). Nightly embeddings for analytics ~40k vectors. p95 latency goal ~350ms.
omar_security: BYO-HSM: supported but only on Dedicated/Private. For hosted customers we can offer envelope-wrapped customer keys (not HSM). We can provide SOC2, subprocessors list, DPIA summary and a template contract clause. Full control-plane geo guarantees need legal sign-off.
lucy_ops: Ops note: subprocessors we use in EU+UK: aws-eu-west-1 (Ireland), aws-eu-west-2 (London), gcp-europe-west1, azure-northeurope, fastcdn-ie, metrics-vendor-eu. I'll export CSV and attach to ticket PRESALES-3210.
respondbot: Ticket PRESALES-3210 created. Attach runbook: https://internal/runbooks/presales-residency.
paul_ae: Commercial asked if we can discount a short dedicated pool for the POC (customer budget constrained) and whether we can commit to a 2-week reserved window.
ivy_se: For 250 qps spikes with p95<350ms, recommend reserved pool: 2x A10 or 1x A100 with warm KV cache; autoscale + prewarmed workers. Short promo is feasible but needs capacity reservation and infra approval.
omar_security: Draft contract sentence for procurement: "Redwood will process, store, and retain inference logs and model artifacts solely within the Customer-specified EU and UK regions for the duration of the POC. Control-plane geographic restrictions require purchase of a Dedicated or Private control-plane; otherwise control-plane telemetry may transit additional regions." Will get legal to review.
lucy_ops: Quick routing sample for their network team (presales doc):
```
routing_policy:
  tenant: retail-xyz
  data_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-2]
  control_plane_mode: dedicated-uk  # requires dedicated control-plane purchase
  kms: byo-hsm
  subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-west-2, gcp-europe-west1, azure-northeurope, fastcdn-ie, metrics-vendor-eu]
  telemetry: minimal
  fallthrough: deny
```
paul_ae: Great. Action items: 1) lucy attach subprocessors CSV + ops playbook to PRESALES-3210 (today). 2) omar to circulate legal-approved appendix draft (tomorrow). 3) ivy to run perf sim and post sizing + cost (tomorrow afternoon). 4) paul to propose 2-week dedicated promo pricing.
sam_sales: I'll ask customer if they're flexible on UK-specific control-plane or if EU-only is enough. If they insist on UK control-plane, we'll push dedicated option. Thanks team. :pray:
